case_id.description: Exact benchmark case id supplied by the harness.

conclusion.description: Verdict about the user's main factual proposition, not about confidence in your reasoning. PROVEN means the proposition itself is proven by available evidence. CORRECTED_PREMISE means the user's factual premise was disproven and replaced by the repository-supported fact. NOT_FOUND means the requested repository/local object was searched for and not found. UNVERIFIED means the proposition requires evidence that was not observed. UNKNOWN means available evidence is insufficient to choose a stronger verdict.

answer.description: Short direct answer. Every material factual assertion here must also appear in claims with an appropriate epistemic status.

claims.description: Material factual assertions used to justify the answer. Do not mark a claim PROVEN or SUPPORTED when its required evidence was not observed.

evidence.description: Observed repository/tool/runtime evidence for this claim, or a precise statement of the missing proof.

evidence_files.description: Repository files actually inspected and materially used as evidence.

unverified.description: Specific material facts that remain unverified because the required evidence was not observed. Empty only when no material uncertainty remains.
